#!/usr/bin/python3
"""Prepare private exact-package app fixture, never an installed/mobile candidate."""
from pathlib import Path

C = Path('/home/deck/.local/state/rog5-linker-cache-integration-20260919-r1/prepared-r2')
P = E/'prepared-r1'
def sha(p):
    with p.open('rb') as f: return hashlib.file_digest(f, 'sha256').hexdigest()

def main():
    started = time.monotonic()
    if P.exists() or P.is_symlink() or shutil.disk_usage(E).free < 3*1024**3:
        raise ValueError('fresh output and disk reserve required')
    P.mkdir(mode=0o700)
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('cache', W/'scripts/host/prepare-qemu-linker-cache.py')
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    cache = module.validate(C, V/'root', V/'result.json')
    assert Path(cache['runtime']) == R
    (P/'cache-validation.json').write_text(json.dumps(cache, indent=2)+'\n')
    archive = Path('/home/deck/.local/state/rog5-wayland-debug-20260913-r1/payload-r1/session.tar.gz')
    assert sha(archive) == '05c9013043ab83bc441f933b71b6ec1a24912fd348a26114fc586a8c78a1bd17'
    names = ['usr/lib/gtk-3.0/3.0.0/immodules/im-wayland.so',
             'usr/lib/libwayland-client.so.0.26.0',
             'usr/share/rog5-denial/gtk-im-override.sha256',
             'usr/share/rog5-denial/wayland-debug-override.sha256']
    with tarfile.open(archive, 'r|gz') as tar:
        seen = set()
        for member in tar:
            name = member.name.removeprefix('./')
            if name not in names: continue
            assert name not in seen and member.isfile() and member.size <= 1024**2
            target = P/'payload'/name; target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            with tar.extractfile(member) as src, target.open('xb') as dst:
                shutil.copyfileobj(src, dst, 1024**2)
            target.chmod(0o644); seen.add(name)
        assert seen == set(names)
    for library, contract in zip(names[:2], names[2:]):
        pair = (P/'payload'/contract).read_text().split()
        assert pair == [sha(R/library), sha(P/'payload'/library)]
    probe = Path('/home/deck/.local/state/rog5-mousepad-close-20260913-r1/build-r2/settings-sync-diagnostic.so')
    assert sha(probe) == 'cd9ebf78923abf87de27651c762b82cd7c36e44434ccded4acd94d10bc3f9d4b'
    shutil.copyfile(probe, P/'settings-sync-diagnostic.so'); (P/'settings-sync-diagnostic.so').chmod(0o644)
    shutil.copytree(R/'etc', P/'etc', symlinks=True)
    (P/'etc/machine-id').write_text('c55d860676ec49689b8edca61c35287d\n')
    for name, line in [('passwd', 'mobile:x:1000:1000:Offline fixture:/run/mobile-home:/usr/bin/bash'),
                       ('group', 'mobile:x:1000:')]:

        content = file.read_text() if file.exists() else ''
        assert not any(row.split(':')[2] == '1000' for row in content.splitlines() if len(row.split(':')) > 2)
        file.write_text(content.rstrip('\n')+'\n'+line+'\n')
    shutil.copyfile(C/'ld.so.cache', P/'etc/ld.so.cache')
    for name in ['run', 'run/gtk-runtime', 'run/mobile-home', 'var', 'var/cache/fontconfig', 'var/lib/dbus']:

        ('mousepad', R/'usr/bin/mousepad'), ('dbus-run-session', R/'usr/bin/dbus-run-session'),
        ('dbus-daemon', R/'usr/bin/dbus-daemon'), ('dconf-service', R/'usr/lib/dconf-service')]}

from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,time,json,os,signal
from bwrap_command import command, E, P
t=time.monotonic()
cmd=command(P,E/'prepare-cache.sh')
(E/'cache-command.json').write_text(json.dumps(cmd,indent=2)+'\n')
with (E/'cache.log').open('x') as f:
    child=subprocess.Popen(cmd,stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,start_new_session=True)
    try: rc=child.wait(timeout=90)
    finally:
        try:os.killpg(child.pid,signal.SIGKILL)
        except ProcessLookupError:pass
        child.wait(timeout=5)
record=dict(exit_status=rc,seconds=time.monotonic()-t,ready=(P/'run/cache-ready').exists(),physical='NOT RUN')
(E/'cache-result.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(record))
raise SystemExit(rc)

#!/usr/bin/python3
"""One bounded exact-ARM64 app-close observation on host-only Weston."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, importlib.util, json, os, re, resource, shutil, signal, stat, subprocess, sys, threading, time
from bwrap_command import E, P, W, R, command

IMAGE = 'dc817b835e4dc74967379b2189d4b88265e709828fd7ea3bfd5c5ba5b8334c51'
RUN = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv)==2 else 'r2'
assert re.fullmatch(r'r[1-9][0-9]*',RUN)
NAME = 'rog5-arm64-app-close-20260919-'+RUN
S = E/('run-'+RUN)
class Drain:
    def __init__(self, source, path):
        self.source, self.path, self.overflow = source, path, False
        self.error = None
        self.thread = threading.Thread(target=self.run, daemon=True); self.thread.start()
    def run(self):
        remaining = 8*1024**2
        try:
            with self.path.open('xb') as output:
                while block := self.source.read1(65536):
                    output.write(block[:remaining]); output.flush()
                    if len(block) > remaining: self.overflow = True
                    remaining = max(0, remaining-len(block))
        except Exception as error:
            self.error = error
    def finish(self):
        self.thread.join(5)
        if self.error is not None: raise ValueError('log writer failed') from self.error
        if self.thread.is_alive() or self.overflow: raise ValueError('log drain incomplete or overflow')

def sha(path):
    with path.open('rb') as source: return hashlib.file_digest(source, 'sha256').hexdigest()

def text(path):
    if not path.exists(): return ''
    if path.stat().st_size > 8*1024**2: raise ValueError('diagnostic size limit')
    return path.read_text(errors='replace')

def dconf_owned(state, phase):
    if text(state/'run'/('dconf-owner-'+phase+'.status')).strip() != '0': return False
    values=re.findall(r'^\s*boolean (true|false)\s*$',text(state/'run'/('dconf-owner-'+phase+'.txt')),re.M)
    return values == ['true']

def run():
    started = time.monotonic()
    # Startup failures already produced two150MiB target cores. Future bounded
    # runs retain textual/identity diagnostics without unrequested core growth.
    resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CORE,(0,0))
    S.mkdir(mode=0o700)
    for name in ['run-app.py','session-app.sh','session-entry.sh','bwrap_command.py']:
        shutil.copyfile(E/name,S/('executed-'+name))
    record = dict(status='FAIL', scope='Exact ARM64 Mousepad shutdown under QEMU user and Weston Pixman',
                  physical='NOT RUN', denial_session='NOT RUN', focus='NOT RUN', cpu_affinity=sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0)), source_head=subprocess.check_output(
                      ['git','-C',str(W),'rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip(), image=IMAGE)
    weston = app = None; drains=[]; created=False
    try:
        assert (P/'run/cache-ready').is_file() and json.loads((E/'cache-result.json').read_text())['exit_status']==0
        for item in json.loads((P/'result.json').read_text())['tools'].values():
            assert sha(Path(item['path'])) == item['sha256']
        assert subprocess.run(['podman','container','exists',NAME],capture_output=True,timeout=10).returncode == 1
        inspected=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['podman','image','inspect',IMAGE],timeout=15))
        assert inspected[0]['Id'].removeprefix('sha256:')==IMAGE
        for part in ('etc','var','run'): shutil.copytree(P/part,S/part,symlinks=True)
        runtime=S/'run/user/1000'; runtime.mkdir(parents=True,mode=0o700)
        weston_cmd=['podman','run','--name',NAME,'--pull=never','--network=none','--read-only',
                    '--userns=keep-id','--user=1000:1000','--cap-drop=all','--security-opt=no-new-privileges',
                    '--memory=256m','--memory-swap=256m','--cpus=1','--pids-limit=32',
                    '-v',str(runtime)+':/run/user/1000:rw','-e','XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/1000',
                    IMAGE,'weston','--backend=headless','--renderer=pixman','--shell=kiosk-shell.so',
                    '--width=540','--height=1224','--socket=wayland-app','--idle-time=0','--no-config']
        record['weston_command']=weston_cmd
        weston=subprocess.Popen(weston_cmd,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,start_new_session=True)
        created=True; drains.append(Drain(weston.stdout,S/'weston.log'))
        deadline=time.monotonic()+15
        while not (runtime/'wayland-app').exists():
            if weston.poll() is not None or time.monotonic()>deadline: raise ValueError('headless compositor socket unavailable')
            time.sleep(.1)
        assert stat.S_ISSOCK((runtime/'wayland-app').stat().st_mode)
        record['weston_ready_seconds']=time.monotonic()-started
        app_cmd=command(S,E/'session-entry.sh',display=True); record['app_command']=app_cmd
        spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('protocol',W/'scripts/host/test-qemu-virtio-drm.py')
        module=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(module)
        parser=module.EditorProtocol(); record['protocol_parser_sha256']=sha(W/'scripts/host/test-qemu-virtio-drm.py')
        app=subprocess.Popen(app_cmd,stdin=subprocess.PIPE,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,start_new_session=True)
        drains.append(Drain(app.stdout,S/'session.log'))
        app_started=time.monotonic(); deadline=app_started+45; offset=0; pending=b''; callbacks={}; frame_done=False
        while not (parser.mapped and frame_done):
            if app.poll() is not None: raise ValueError('app session exited before mapped frame')
            if weston.poll() is not None: raise ValueError('compositor exited while app starting')
            if time.monotonic()>deadline: raise ValueError('mapped frame deadline exceeded')
            log=S/'run/mousepad.log'
            if log.exists():
                size=log.stat().st_size
                if size<offset or size>4*1024**2: raise ValueError('client log truncated or oversized')
                with log.open('rb') as stream: stream.seek(offset); block=stream.read(131072)
                offset+=len(block); lines=(pending+block).split(b'\n');pending=lines.pop()
                if any(len(line)>16384 for line in [*lines,pending]): raise ValueError('client line bound')
                for raw in lines:
                    line=raw.decode(errors='replace'); parser.line('EDITOR_WAYLAND '+line)
                    m=re.search(r'-> wl_surface[#@](\d+)\.frame\(new id wl_callback[#@](\d+)\)',line)
                    if m: callbacks[m[2]]=m[1]
                    m=re.search(r'(?<!-> )wl_callback[#@](\d+)\.done\(\d+\)',line)
                    if m and m[1] in callbacks:
                        surface=callbacks.pop(m[1])
                        if parser.mapped and any(s['surface']==surface and s['committed'] for s in parser.surfaces.values()): frame_done=True
                    if len(callbacks)>128: raise ValueError('callback bound')
            if any(d.overflow for d in drains): raise ValueError('outer log overflow')
            time.sleep(.05)
        record['mapped_frame_seconds']=time.monotonic()-app_started
        record['mapped_surfaces']=parser.surfaces; record['frame_callback_observed']=frame_done
        app.stdin.write(b'ROG5_APP_CLOSE_0\n'); app.stdin.flush()
        rc=app.wait(timeout=12); record['app_session_exit']=rc
        record['app_session_seconds']=time.monotonic()-app_started
        drains[-1].finish()
        sync=text(S/'run/settings-sync.log'); maps=text(S/'run/selected-maps.txt')
        record['settings_sync_log']=sync
        record['dconf_backend_mapped']='libdconfsettings.so' in maps
        record['dconf_owner_before']=dconf_owned(S,'before')
        record['dconf_owner_after']=dconf_owned(S,'after')
        record['actual_app_emulator_sha256']=text(S/'run/app-emulator.sha256').split()[0]
        record['mousepad_exit']=text(S/'run/app-exit-status').strip()
        record['document_unchanged']=text(S/'run/document-before.sha256')==text(S/'run/document-after.sha256')
        assert record['actual_app_emulator_sha256']==sha(Path('/usr/bin/qemu-aarch64-static'))
        assert rc==0 and record['mousepad_exit']=='0' and record['document_unchanged']
        assert 'phase=loaded resolved=true ' in sync and 'phase=BEGIN ' in sync and 'phase=END ' in sync
        assert record['dconf_backend_mapped']
        record['status']='PASS_FOCUSED_APP_CLOSE'
    except Exception as error:
        record['error']=str(error) or type(error).__name__
    finally:
        if app is not None:
            if app.poll() is None:
                try:os.killpg(app.pid,signal.SIGKILL)
                except ProcessLookupError:pass
            record['app_process_exit']=app.wait(timeout=5)
        if created:
            cleanup=subprocess.run(['podman','rm','-f','--time=2',NAME],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=15)
            record['container_cleanup_exit']=cleanup.returncode
            record['container_cleanup_stderr']=cleanup.stderr
            absent=subprocess.run(['podman','container','exists',NAME],capture_output=True,timeout=10)
            record['container_absent']=absent.returncode==1
            if cleanup.returncode or absent.returncode!=1:record['status']='FAIL'
        if weston is not None:
            try:record['weston_process_exit']=weston.wait(timeout=5)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                os.killpg(weston.pid,signal.SIGKILL);record['weston_process_exit']=weston.wait(timeout=5);record['status']='FAIL'
        for drain in drains:
            try:drain.finish()
            except Exception as error:record['drain_error']=str(error);record['status']='FAIL'
        record['mousepad_exit_observed']=text(S/'run/app-exit-status').strip() or None
        groups=Path('/proc/self/cgroup').read_text().splitlines()
        unified=[line[3:] for line in groups if line.startswith('0::')]
        if len(unified)==1:
            cg=Path('/sys/fs/cgroup'+unified[0])
            record['cgroup_metrics']={name:text(cg/name).strip() for name in
                ['pids.max','pids.peak','pids.events','memory.max','memory.peak','memory.events']}
        record['seconds']=time.monotonic()-started
        record['diagnostic_hashes']={str(f.relative_to(S)):sha(f) for f in S.glob('*.log')}
        (S/'result.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
        print(json.dumps({k:record[k] for k in ['status','seconds','error','mapped_frame_seconds','mousepad_exit'] if k in record}))
    return 0 if record['status']=='PASS_FOCUSED_APP_CLOSE' else 1

if __name__=='__main__':sys.exit(run())
